g.text: (orange, requirement to metric; evidence on the line)
thick: the requirement and the metric read the same calc or measured quantity
dashed: they share only a calc further upstream, or the model's prose says so (doc)
green metric: a requirement relation exists in the model; dashed white: traded, none in the model
(grey): from the analysis def, or from the measurement of the slew
Requirement placement in a subsystem is the analyst's reading (CaseSpec groups metrics)
